name: Tripleseat
oneLiner: Event sales and management platform for restaurants, hotels and venues, handling event leads, proposals, BEOs, contracts and payments.
bestFor: Restaurants, restaurant groups and hotels with an active private dining, group booking or catering business.

updates.text: Integration with Reserve with Google so venues can capture event inquiries directly from Google Search and Maps.
PartyPay online card payments expanded beyond the US to the UK, Canada, Australia and Europe, part of Tripleseat's 2025 feature round-up that also added sales goals by user or location.

features: Event lead capture from website forms, TripleseatDirect and Google
Banquet event orders (BEOs) and event documents
Calendar and space availability across rooms and locations
Online payments and deposits through PartyPay
Guest CRM with booking history and spend
Sales goals and event revenue reporting by user and location
AI tools for drafting venue descriptions and responding to leads

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Tripleseat does not publish software prices (quote on request). PartyPay processing is pay-as-you-go.

notes: File slug is 'tripeseat' (typo in the post), product name is Tripleseat. Dropped from the current review: 'typically starts around $499/month' (no vendor source; third-party estimates differ), customers Kimpton Hotels, Fox Restaurant Concepts and Levy Restaurants (not confirmed in this search), 'most widely adopted' (unverifiable). Tripleseat says it serves 20,000+ venues (vendor claim). The PartyPay international launch was dated July 15, 2025 in a Hotel News Resource listing; the cited source is Tripleseat's 2025 recap. Tripleseat also announced an AI platform, 'Tripleseat Intelligence' (https://martechseries.com/predictive-ai/ai-platforms-machine-learning/tripleseat-unveils-ai-suite-to-transform-event-management/), but its date could not be confirmed, so it is not in updates. Also: March 2025 TimeForge partnership on event staffing (no URL captured), General Atlantic strategic investment and acquisition of Gather (dates not confirmed). User conference renamed Tripleseat Ignite (Aug 25-26, 2026, Boston).
